identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Risankizumab in Crohn's Disease
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3 Study of Risankizumab (Anti-IL-23) for Induction of Remission in Moderate-to-Severe Crohn's Disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety of risankizumab, an anti-IL-23 p19 monoclonal antibody, in patients with moderately to severely active Crohn's disease.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants receive intravenous induction dosing followed by subcutaneous maintenance. The primary endpoint is clinical remission at week 12.

interventions.name: Risankizumab
interventions.description: Anti-IL-23 p19 monoclonal antibody administered IV then SC.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Inclusion: adults with moderate-to-severe Crohn's disease. Exclusion: prior anti-IL-23 exposure.
